name: Mace of Smiting

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +1 mace (+3 against Constructs); a 20 deals an extra 7 Bludgeoning (14 against a Construct) and can shatter a Construct.
text: This magic mace grants +1 to attack and damage rolls, rising to +3 against Constructs. Rolling a 20 on an attack with it adds 7 Bludgeoning damage, or 14 if the target is a Construct, and a Construct reduced to 25 Hit Points or fewer by that hit is destroyed.
